name: Tenryuu Ena
source: Ena is from Shizuoka Prefecture; her name comes from the Tenryū-ku ward of Hamamatsu. During her junior-high school years, she was a junior of Minami Umeda, but afterwards transferred to Shizuoka Prefecture. She is usually a cheerful girl who is frank and manages the soccer club.
